units.source_text: 矿车到了竹林地区，渐渐地停了下来。

en.t: The mine cart reached the bamboo grove area and gradually came to a stop.

units.source_text: 三个人又像刚才一般，开始下车继续推这辆沉重的矿车。

en.t: The three of them again got down as before and began pushing the heavy mine cart onward.

units.source_text: 不知何时起，竹林消失了，取而代之的是杂树林。

en.t: At some point, the bamboo grove had disappeared, replaced by a mixed wood.

units.source_text: 缓缓上坡的路上堆满了落叶，几乎淹没了锈得发红的铁轨。

en.t: The gently rising road was piled with fallen leaves, almost burying the iron rails that had rusted red.

units.source_text: 沿着这条路推着矿车，好不容易才登上坡顶。

en.t: Pushing the mine cart along this road, they finally managed to reach the top of the slope.

units.source_text: 站在坡顶，蓝色的霞光、带着寒意的辽阔的大海在眼前徐徐展开。

en.t: Standing at the top of the slope, blue haze and the vast chill-tinged sea slowly opened out before their eyes.

units.source_text: 这个时候，良平立刻意识到，自己走的有点太远了。

en.t: At that moment, Ryohei immediately realized that he had gone a little too far.
